text:
Aisha Rahman: quick design pass on Security > Data retention + encryption UI. dropped a few comments in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ789 — main asks: clearer labels, hide raw key ids, fix badge contrast, tab order for toggles
Tom Becker: can you paste the exact copy changes here so i can push a tiny copy PR?
Aisha Rahman: sure, short list below. prefer plain language for legal reviewers.
Aisha Rahman: - "Retention period (days) — how long logs and request bodies are stored" 
Aisha Rahman: - Help text: "Shorter retention reduces storage costs and exposure. Some compliance regimes require specific retention windows."
Aisha Rahman: - Region selector: replace placeholder 'Global' with 'Serving region (data residency)' and tooltip 'Storage and encryption are scoped by region.'
Lina Wu: UX: for KMS toggle change label to 'Customer-managed encryption key (CMK)' and add secondary microcopy 'Recommended: Managed key (easier) | Advanced: CMK'. hide provider tokens unless CMK selected.
Samir Singh: a11y items: CMK toggle needs role="switch" + aria-checked. Ensure focus order: retention slider -> region -> CMK toggle -> submit. Current order jumps to close button.
Samir Singh: also the green 'ENCRYPTED' badge fails AA at 12px; propose darker color #0b6b2f or 2px stroke for small sizes.
Tom Becker: legal note: don't imply cross-cloud key portability. show vendor mapping only after user opts into CMK (e.g., 'AWS KMS, GCP CMEK, Azure BYOK').
Aisha Rahman: sample sanitized audit log row for mockups: 
```
2026-03-21T09:12:03Z • rbecker@example.com • Export logs • Resource: inference-555 • Encryption: Customer-managed key (AWS KMS, us-east-1) • Key id hidden
```
Lina Wu: thanks, will update Figma frames and add a11y overlays. @design-bot can you snapshot the updated frames?
design-bot: Snapshot created: https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ789?node-id=789:101 (frame: security-retention-kms-update)
Aisha Rahman: target: merge copy + markup PR by EOD Thu so eng can pick up for next staging build. :thumbsup:
Tom Becker: i'll do the PR and include Samir's aria notes. tagging legal for quick review on cloud wording.
Lina Wu: small nit — change tooltip icon to use aria-label="Help: more info" for screen readers.
Samir Singh: noted, will validate with Axe once in staging.
Aisha Rahman: thanks team — small fixes but high impact for compliance customers.
